latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Drama — Turn Footage into Dramatic Scenes

- Instantly transforms raw video clips into cinematic dramatic scenes with AI.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB in MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM formats; outputs 1080p MP4 video.
- Handles user prompts for adding dramatic music, color grading, tension-building cuts, and more.
- Fully cloud-based: automatic account and session setup with up to 100 free credits for new users.
- Simple chat-based commands for uploading, editing, exporting video, checking credits, and more.
- Fast processing (typically 1–2 minutes) with easy download link on completion.
